  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `render_suspect_commits_section`, the check `shown = f", newest {len(commits)} shown" if total > len(commits) and len(commits) >= SUSPECT_COMMITS_MAX else ""` uses the length of the list after the cap was applied to guess whether the cap cut anything. When `parse_suspect_compare` drops a malformed entry and exactly 15 valid commits are left (for example total_commits=16, 16 raw commits, one malformed SHA), the caption says "16 commits, newest 15 shown" even though the cap hid nothing. If the malformed entry was the newest one, the 15 commits listed are not the newest.
  WHY: The pre-cap length is lost at `parsed[-SUSPECT_COMMITS_MAX:]`, so the renderer cannot tell cap truncation apart from validation drops. `commits_page_truncated` does not apply because GitHub returned every entry. The only test covers total_commits=4, so this boundary is untested. All four reviewers rated it SEVERITY: NIT (shown here as low). The suggested fix is to record `len(parsed) > SUSPECT_COMMITS_MAX` as a flag in the result, use that flag for the caption, and add a test with total=16 and one malformed entry.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: `len(commits) >= SUSPECT_COMMITS_MAX` is used to mean "the cap cut something", but doc["commits"] has already been cut to 15 (parsed[-SUSPECT_COMMITS_MAX:] in parse_suspect_compare). The renderer therefore cannot tell a real cap cut apart from validation dropping malformed entries until exactly 15 were left.
  WHY: With total_commits=16, 16 commits listed and one malformed SHA, commits_page_truncated=False and 15 commits pass validation, so the caption says "16 commits, newest 15 shown" although the cap hid nothing. The new test only covers total_commits=4. The suggested hardening is to set result["commits_capped"] = len(parsed) > SUSPECT_COMMITS_MAX, have the render step check doc.get("commits_capped") is True, and add a test with total=16 and one malformed SHA (about 4 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1). The reviewer also checked that the expectations in test_intake_suspect_commits_reuses_the_reproduction_last_green (calls=2, slow_day_commits=2, no sha=) hold against the harness (lines 1816-1828, 2046-2073, 1261-1265).
